context: Reference implementation: block lambdas in Map.merge, computeIfAbsent, and CompletableFuture callbacks.

checklist.name: Creates the requested artifact
checklist.description: Creates FeedingLedger.java with the three methods, the three nested records, needed imports, and Java 17-compatible code.

checklist.name: Preserves ledger semantics
checklist.description: totalsByTank sums grams, counts feedings, and keeps the latest fedAt per tank in encounter order; feedingsByKeeper groups in encounter order; reportFor counts and sums only feedings with the matching tankId.

checklist.name: Merge accumulation uses a named helper
checklist.description: The Map.merge remapping callback is a method reference or one-expression lambda that delegates to a named method (for example FeedingTotal::plus or FeedingLedger::combine); the accumulation of grams, count, and latest instant is not written as a block lambda inside merge.

checklist.name: Report building uses a named helper
checklist.description: The thenApply callback is a method reference or one-expression lambda that calls a named method building the TankReport; filtering, counting, and summing are not written as a block lambda inside thenApply.

checklist.name: computeIfAbsent stays glue
checklist.description: The computeIfAbsent mapping function is a one-expression callback such as k -> new ArrayList<>() or ignored -> new ArrayList<>(), not a block lambda.

checklist.name: No block lambdas anywhere
checklist.description: No callback body in the file uses braces or continues onto further lines; extracted helpers contain plain code rather than another block lambda.

checklist.name: Stays focused
checklist.description: No unrelated abstractions, synchronization, executors, extra public API, or dependency changes.
